title: PR8319 Staging Host Breakglass Compose database transport

phases.objective: Route Staging Host Breakglass database access through the existing Docker Compose app network while retaining Windows as the governed authority surface and preserving all Production and mutation boundaries.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Run an exact-SHA Staging Host Breakglass database repair dry-run through the verified local request path on Windows.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The Windows-controlled Host Breakglass runner can reach Compose-internal database service DNS through the bounded app-service bridge without exposing database ports or credentials in Docker argv; dry-run remains non-mutating and Production authority remains denied.
steps: Keep staging_local_windows_docker and the Windows platform guard as the execution authority boundary.
Resolve the repository-owned Compose files, Staging env file, and bounded app bridge service from the Staging Host Breakglass contract.
Spawn docker compose exec without a shell and exchange database protocol requests over bounded stdio.
Pass the injected connectionFactory through runBootstrap and selective-rebuild readback without altering execution-ticket or confirmation semantics.
Keep database credentials out of Docker argv and public error envelopes.
Require live Staging certification for the shared-runtime change before relying on the transport operationally.
Keep Production mutation, migration apply, grants apply, provider mutation, deployment, and credential mutation outside this PR.
assertions: The Compose bridge service is repository-configured and service names are syntax-bounded.
Database credentials are sent over stdin protocol rather than Docker argv.
The existing Windows Host Breakglass platform guard remains enforced.
The same Compose connection factory is preserved for post-selective-rebuild readback.
A Staging dry-run may connect to the database but reports database_mutation_performed=false and migration_apply_performed=false.
Production mutation is not authorized by this transport repair.
